messageValues.message: Prepend exactly 1 emoji + a space to content. Context: 6Crcx5cJrWQ6w4cG=food/groceries, 6gfWcx5q832xJ6XJ=tech. Choose the MOST SPECIFIC emoji for the exact item named (e.g. the specific fruit, vegetable, drink, tool, or gadget) rather than a generic catch-all. Do NOT default to 🍴, 🛒, or 📦 unless no specific emoji could possibly apply. Do not repeat the same emoji across different items unless the items are genuinely the same thing. Only return the modified content string. DO NOT CHANGE THE TEXT itself, DO NOT include an id. JSON ONLY.
